pinned_sources.role: HLA-A/B/C genotype and allele-specific expression in the assayed TCGA cohort; parent article reports aggregate HLA-type counts.
pinned_sources.caveat: TCGA-selected participants. Genotyping and RNA abundance do not measure malignant cell surface peptide display. Use exact sample-type, missingness and patient deduplication rules before analysis. Store only aggregate outputs.
